entry.title: Taxes · Mon, Nov 2, 2026
entry.summary:
Proposed: Public Hearing Request on Tax Exemption for Roanoke Area Ministries. The consent agenda proposed scheduling and advertising a public hearing for November 16, 2026, to consider a real property tax exemption for property owned by Roanoke Area Ministries.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6593,plainText=false)

entry.title: Taxes · Mon, May 18, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Real Property Tax Exemption for 2750 Hoover Street and 1729 Patterson Avenue. Council adopted Ordinance No. 43400-051826 granting real property tax exemption requests for properties owned by Villa Heights Rec Center, LLC and 1729 Patterson Avenue, LLC (operated under Restoration Housing). Recorded vote: 6-1.
Adopted: Real Property Tax Exemption for 725 Franklin Road, SW. Council approved Ordinance No. 43401-051826 approving a real property tax exemption for property owned by Assisi Animal Clinics of Virginia, Inc. at 725 Franklin Road, SW. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6490,plainText=false)

entry.title: Taxes · Mon, May 11, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Reaffirmation of Real Estate Tax Rate. City Council adopted Ordinance No. 43385-051126 reaffirming the real estate tax rate on a 6-1 vote, with Council Member Hagen voting no. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6475,plainText=false)

entry.title: Taxes · Mon, May 4, 2026
entry.summary:
Hearing scheduled: Public Hearing Scheduling for Property Tax Exemptions for Villa Heights Rec Center and Patterson Avenue Properties. City Council concurred with a request to schedule a public hearing on May 18, 2026, regarding real property tax exemptions for Villa Heights Rec Center, LLC, and 1729 Patterson Avenue, LLC (Restoration Housing). Recorded vote: 7-0.
Hearing scheduled: Public Hearing Scheduling for Property Tax Exemption for Assisi Animal Clinics of Virginia. City Council agreed to schedule a public hearing for May 18, 2026, regarding real property tax exemption for Assisi Animal Clinics of Virginia, Inc. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6465,plainText=false)

entry.title: Taxes · Tue, Sep 8, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Joint Meeting Discussion on School Budget, Capital Realities, and Sales Tax Referendum. City Council and the Roanoke City School Board held a joint meeting with discussions covering an opening of schools prelude, an RCPS budget report from the RCPS CFO, an overview of RCPS and City of Roanoke capital realities, an overview and discussion of a 1% sales tax referendum, and the City Council/School Board buddy system.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6556,plainText=false)

entry.title: Taxes · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Public Follow-Up on Meals Tax Revenue and City Facility Projects. Staff reported that following an inquiry about meals tax revenue and deferred maintenance projects, the August 2026 Monthly Financial Report and project breakdowns for HVAC and elevator modernizations were provided to a resident via the FOIA Officer.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6588,plainText=false)
